declarations.name: UIAccordion
declarations.summary: An accordion lets people show and hide sections of content.
declarations.description:
An accordion lets people show and hide sections of content.

Also known as:  collapse, collapsible, disclosure, expander, details, faq.

attributes.name: styled
attributes.description: A boxed accordion:  bordered, bold titles, padded content.

attributes.name: fluid
attributes.description: Takes the full width of its container.

attributes.name: inverted
attributes.description: The dark scheme, for a dark background.

attributes.name: basic
attributes.description: With `styled`:  no box, no rules between titles -- only the styled spacing and title colours.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Less padding around titles and content;  `compact="very"` less still (`very compact`).

attributes.name: tree
attributes.description: Indents each panel's content under its title, like a file tree (nested accordions line up).

attributes.name: exclusive
attributes.description: Only one panel open at a time (a `<details name>` group):  opening one closes the others.  `exclusive="no"` lets any number stay open.

attributes.name: collapsible
attributes.description: The open panel closes when its title is activated;  `collapsible="no"` keeps one open.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Indexes of the open panels (0-based), space-separated:  `open="0"`, `open="0 2"`.  Controlled:  set it to open / close panels;  `ui-open` / `ui-close` can veto people's changes.  When `exclusive`, only the first index counts.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: URL of an HTML file whose `<body>` is the content, fetched the first time it opens (at once when it starts open);  same origin only.  Any content already there is a placeholder the file replaces.  `load()` fetches it now, `reload()` again.

attributes.name: select
attributes.description: With `source`:  a CSS selector;  only its first match in the file becomes the content.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Can't be used:  dimmed, out of the tab order, and everything inside it inert;  `aria-disabled`.  Shared by every element;  a family may give it a meaning of its own (`elementSetup.disabled`).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Busy:  dimmed under a loader, and inert;  `aria-busy`.  Shared by every element;  a family may draw its own loader (`elementSetup.loading`).

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

events.name: ui-open
events.description: A panel is about to open;  `preventDefault()` keeps it closed.  NOT cancelable in effect when the browser opened it itself (find-in-page).  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ index: number, open: true, title: Element, content?: Element, originalEvent?: Event }>

events.name: ui-close
events.description: A panel is about to close -- its title was activated, or another panel is opening in an `exclusive` accordion;  `preventDefault()` keeps it open (and then the other one closed).  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ index: number, open: false, title: Element, content?: Element, originalEvent?: Event }>

events.name: ui-load
events.description: The `source` file arrived and its body is in place (`content` is the file's text).

events.name: ui-error
events.description: The `source` file couldn't be loaded or shown;  `kind` says why.  An error line shows in the content unless cancelled;  opening it again tries again.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ kind: 'load' | 'cross-origin' | 'file-protocol' | 'render', source: string, error: unknown }>

slots.description: Title + content pairs:  each `<ui-title>` starts a panel, the element after it is its content (usually a `<ui-content>`).  Other children are not shown.

cssParts.name: title
cssParts.description: A panel's `<summary class="title">`:  the control that opens and closes it.

cssParts.name: icon
cssParts.description: The dropdown arrow in a title, turned down while the panel is open.

cssParts.name: error
cssParts.description: With `source`:  the line saying the file couldn't be loaded.

cssStates.name: open
cssStates.description: At least one panel is open.

cssStates.name: animated
cssStates.description: Panels open and close with a height transition (`interpolate-size`).

cssStates.name: in-accordion
cssStates.description: Nested in another accordion:  it takes that one's look.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: With `source`:  fetching the file.

cssStates.name: loaded
cssStates.description: With `source`:  the file's body is in place.

cssStates.name: error
cssStates.description: With `source`:  the file couldn't be loaded or shown.

cssStates.name: disabled
cssStates.description: `disabled` is set (or, on a form control, a `<fieldset disabled>` around it).

cssStates.name: busy
cssStates.description: `loading`, and the element draws the shared loader:  a spinner over it (`elementSetup.loading`).

cssStates.name: dimmed
cssStates.description: Disabled or loading the shared way:  everything inside is inert, and dimmed.

cssStates.name: hidden
cssStates.description: `visible="false"`:  hidden, once its animation has run.

declarations.name: UIButton
declarations.summary: A button indicates a possible action.
declarations.description:
A button indicates a possible action.

Also known as:  btn, action, submit, link button.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size, `mini` ... `massive`;  `medium` is the default.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Hue;  fills the button (or its ring and text when `basic`).

attributes.name: primary
attributes.description: Primary emphasis:  the `primary` brand colour.

attributes.name: secondary
attributes.description: Secondary emphasis:  the `secondary` brand colour.

attributes.name: positive
attributes.description: Positive consequence:  the `positive` colour.

attributes.name: negative
attributes.description: Negative consequence:  the `negative` colour.

attributes.name: basic
attributes.description: Less pronounced:  transparent with a hairline ring.

attributes.name: tertiary
attributes.description: Least pronounced:  text only, underlined on hover.

attributes.name: inverted
attributes.description: For dark backgrounds:  an outline that fills on hover.

attributes.name: toggle
attributes.description: Toggles `active` on click, with `aria-pressed`;  dispatches `ui-toggle`.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Pressed / on;  with `toggle`, in the positive colour.

attributes.name: active-text
attributes.description: Fomantic's `state` behaviour:  the text while `active` (`Following`), instead of the content.  With either state text the label carries the state, so a `toggle` drops `aria-pressed` (WAI-ARIA APG).

attributes.name: inactive-text
attributes.description: Fomantic's `state` behaviour:  the text while NOT `active` (`Follow`), instead of the content.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Can't be used;  dimmed and inert.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows a spinner in place of the content;  `aria-busy`.

attributes.name: fluid
attributes.description: Takes the full width of its container.

attributes.name: circular
attributes.description: Pill shaped;  round when it holds only an icon.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Reduced padding.

attributes.name: labeled
attributes.description: With `icon`:  the icon in its own block, `labeled` (start) or `labeled="right"`.  With `label`:  which side the label goes, `labeled` (end) or `labeled="left"`.

attributes.name: animated
attributes.description: Slides the `icon` slot in over the content on hover:  sideways, `fade` or `vertical`.

attributes.name: attached
attributes.description: Joined to the edge of a segment or another element:  `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`.

attributes.name: floated
attributes.description: Floats `left` or `right`.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Icon name (Font Awesome, Fomantic aliases allowed).  With no text content the button gets the `icon` class (square padding);  with `labeled` it becomes a `labeled icon` button.

attributes.name: icon-position
attributes.description: Which side of the text the icon goes:  `left` (default) or `right` (Fomantic's `right` icon, e.g. `Next →`), spaced by `--ui-button-icon-spacing`.  A `labeled` icon block takes its side from `labeled`.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Shorthand for the button's text, instead of the default slot;  slotted children win.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Shorthand for a joined label, e.g. a count;  renders `ui labeled button` around the button.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Form behaviour, as the native `<button type>`;  `submit` calls `form.requestSubmit()`.

attributes.name: commandfor
attributes.description: Invoker commands, as the native `<button commandfor>`:  the id of the element `command` acts on, looked up in the button's own tree (the inner `<button>` gets it as `commandForElement`, since a shadow button can't see a light-DOM id).  Without browser support (`UI.browser.supports.invokers`) a click runs the built-in commands itself.

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Invoker commands, as the native `<button command>`:  `show-modal` / `close` / `request-close` on a `<dialog>`, `show-popover` / `hide-popover` / `toggle-popover` on a popover, or a custom `--name` that the target hears as a `command` event (`<ui-modal>` answers `--show`, `--close`, `--toggle`).

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders a link (`<a>`) styled as a button.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Link target, with `href`.

attributes.name: download
attributes.description: With `href`:  downloads the file instead of opening it, as the native `<a download>`;  a value names the saved file.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name submitted with the button's `value`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Form value submitted when this button submits the form.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

events.name: ui-toggle
events.description: A `toggle` button flipped its `active` state.  NOTE: plain clicks are the native `click`.

slots.description: Content, usually text;  instead of the `content` attribute.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Icon, instead of the `icon` attribute;  the hidden content of `animated`.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Label content, instead of the `label` attribute.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The joined label of a `label` button.

cssStates.description: Pressed / on.

cssStates.description: The host floats left (`floated="left"`).

cssStates.description: The host floats right (`floated="right"`).

cssStates.description: `loading`, and the element draws the shared loader:  a spinner over it (`elementSetup.loading`).

declarations.name: UICalendar
declarations.summary: A calendar lets a person pick a date, a time, or both.
declarations.description:
A calendar lets a person pick a date, a time, or both.

Also known as:  date picker, datepicker, time picker, datetime, date range.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size, `mini` ... `massive`;  `medium` is the default.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Hue of the chosen cell, the range and the focus ring (a remap of `--ui-color`).

attributes.name: inverted
attributes.description: For dark backgrounds:  the dark scheme's colours.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Tighter cells.

attributes.name: fluid
attributes.description: The field takes the full width of its container.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Can't be used;  dimmed and inert, left out of the form.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: The popup is open.  Controlled:  set it to open / close;  `ui-open` / `ui-close` can veto.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: What it picks, and the ISO shape of `value`;  Fomantic's default `datetime`.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: The grid sits in the page (no field, no popup);  still a form control.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Where the popup opens against the field;  it flips when there's no room.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Chosen value, ISO by `type`.  The ATTRIBUTE is the starting value (form reset restores it);  the property is current.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name;  submits the ISO value.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Form validation:  a value must be chosen.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Shows its value but can't be changed;  submitted with the form (unlike `disabled`).

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text shown in the empty field;  its accessible name too.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest value that can be chosen, ISO by `type`.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Latest value that can be chosen, ISO by `type`.

attributes.name: initial-date
attributes.description: Where the grid starts while there's no value (ISO);  default today.

attributes.name: first-day-of-week
attributes.description: First column of the day grid, `0` = Sunday ... `6`;  default from the locale's week info.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: BCP 47 locale for names, formats and the 12 / 24 hour clock;  default `UI.i18n.locale`.

attributes.name: today
attributes.description: Shows a Today (or Now) button under the grid.

attributes.name: disable-minute
attributes.description: Times stop at the hour:  no minute grid.

attributes.name: disable-month
attributes.description: No month grid:  the day grid's title goes to years.

attributes.name: disable-year
attributes.description: No year grid:  the month grid's title goes to days.

attributes.name: select-adjacent-days
attributes.description: Days of the previous / next month in the day grid can be chosen (else they're disabled).

attributes.name: start-calendar
attributes.description: Id of the calendar holding the START of a range:  this one is the end (min = its value).

attributes.name: end-calendar
attributes.description: Id of the calendar holding the END of a range:  this one is the start (max = its value).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Icon of the popup button;  default (or bare `icon`) `calendar`, `clock` for `time`.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Busy:  dimmed under a loader, and inert;  `aria-busy`.  Shared by every element;  a family may draw its own loader (`elementSetup.loading`).

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

members.name: disabledDates
members.description: PROPERTY:  days that can't be chosen, as ISO date strings (`["2026-12-25"]`).  A JS property (rich data), not an attribute.

members.name: disabledDaysOfWeek
members.description: PROPERTY:  weekdays that can't be chosen, `0` = Sunday ... `6` (`[0, 6]` for weekends).  A JS property (rich data), not an attribute.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: The person chose, typed or cleared a value;  `preventDefault()` keeps the old one.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

events.name: ui-open
events.description: The popup is about to open;  `preventDefault()` keeps it closed.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

events.name: ui-close
events.description: The popup is about to close;  `preventDefault()` keeps it open.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

cssParts.name: input
cssParts.description: The field's box (`ui input`), popup calendars only.

attributes.name: header
attributes.description: Title text;  a slotted `slot="header"` is the rich version (code, links).

attributes.name: subhead
attributes.description: Smaller text under the title;  scrolls away with the content, never sticks.  Or `slot="subhead"`.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Heading level of the title (`<h1>` ... `<h6>`);  default:  the enclosing section's level + 1, else 2 (under the page's `h1`).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Icon name, before the title;  a slotted `slot="icon"` (a `<ui-icon>`, anything) replaces it.

attributes.name: badge
attributes.description: A small pill after the title, e.g. a count (`3/7`);  `slot="badge"` is the rich version.

attributes.name: info
attributes.description: A tip about the section, shown under the title bar while the pointer is on the title (or the fold button has keyboard focus);  it describes the title.  `slot="info"` is the rich version (bold words, line breaks).

attributes.name: collapsible
attributes.description: The title folds and unfolds the content:  a button with `aria-expanded`.  Default:  on inside `<ui-sections collapsing>`, sub-sections included;  `collapsible="false"` opts out there.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Folded:  only the title shows.  Controlled:  set it to fold / unfold;  `ui-open` / `ui-close` can veto a person's changes.  Find-in-page unfolds a match.

attributes.name: fold-icon
attributes.description: Where each band's fold chevron sits:  `end`, at the far end of the band after any actions (the panel's default), or `start`, before the title.

attributes.name: sticky
attributes.description: The title bar sticks while the section is on screen;  a sticky section inside another sticks just below its title.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: With `sticky`:  pixels between the top edge and a TOP-LEVEL section's stuck title (e.g. a page header's height);  nested sections work theirs out.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Hue of the whole panel:  the header band, the box, the border and the sub-head bands (sub-panels follow it).  None:  `primary`.  Any hue, including one a theme adds (`spell-brand`'s `accent`, Polished Ivory).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Text size of the CONTENT, `mini` ... `massive`;  the title keeps its level's size.

attributes.name: dividing
attributes.description: A rule under the title.

attributes.name: block
attributes.description: The title bar in a tinted box.

attributes.name: bordered
attributes.description: A box around the section, as a segment.

attributes.name: styled
attributes.description: Boxed as a styled accordion:  a tinted title bar over padded content.

attributes.name: raised
attributes.description: With a box:  lifted with a shadow.

attributes.name: basic
attributes.description: No box, rule or tint, whatever else is set.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Less padding and space around the title.

attributes.name: padded
attributes.description: More padding in the content;  `padded="very"` for even more.

attributes.name: attached
attributes.description: With a box:  joined edge to edge with the box above / below;  bare `attached` sits between two.

attributes.name: scrolling
attributes.description: The content has a capped height and scrolls;  `short` ... `very long` scale the cap.

attributes.name: height

attributes.name: text-align
attributes.description: Aligns the TITLE `left`, `center` or `right`.

attributes.name: inverted
attributes.description: For dark backgrounds:  the dark scheme.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Dims the content under a spinner;  `aria-busy`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Dimmed and inert;  can't be folded.

attributes.name: source

attributes.name: select
attributes.description: With `source`:  a CSS selector;  only its first match in the file becomes the content.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

events.name: ui-open
events.description: About to unfold:  the title was activated, or find-in-page matched inside (not cancelable then, `cancelable: false`).  Cancel to stay folded.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ open: boolean, section: Element, originalEvent?: Event }>

events.name: ui-close

type.text: CustomEvent<{ open: boolean, section: Element, originalEvent?: Event }>

events.name: ui-load
events.description: The `source` file arrived and its body is in place (`content` is the file's text).

events.name: ui-error
events.description: The `source` file couldn't be loaded or shown;  `kind` says why.  An error line shows in the content unless cancelled;  opening it again tries again.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

declarations.description:
A toast gives people a short, non-blocking notification.

Also known as:  snackbar, notification, growl, flash message, toaster.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Consequence (Fomantic's `class`), tinting it like a colour;  `error` also announces it as an alert.

attributes.name: inverted
attributes.description: The dark scheme;  a coloured one takes its light variant.

attributes.description: Bold first line (Fomantic's `title`).

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Body text;  slotted content follows it.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Icon name beside the content;  bare `icon` (or `"true"`, as frameworks write it) uses the type's own (info, check, warning, cross).

attributes.name: closable
attributes.description: Shows a close icon (Fomantic's `closeIcon`).

attributes.name: close-on-click
attributes.description: A click anywhere on it closes it (Fomantic's `closeOnClick`);  off anyway with `closable`, actions or form controls inside.

attributes.name: display-time
attributes.description: Milliseconds before it closes itself;  absent or `0` keeps it until closed;  `auto` ~== reading time (120 words a minute, at least a second).  `UI.toast()` defaults to `3000`.

attributes.name: progress
attributes.description: Shows a bar counting the display time down, at the `top` or `bottom` (Fomantic's `showProgress`).

attributes.name: progress-up
attributes.description: The bar fills up instead of emptying.

attributes.name: pause-on-hover
attributes.description: Pauses the countdown while the pointer is over it.  Focus inside ALWAYS pauses it.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: A fixed width (350px);  `compact="false"` sizes it to its content.

attributes.name: actions
attributes.description: Layout words of the `actions` slot (Fomantic's `classActions`):  `basic` (no bar), `left` (aligned left), `attached` (joined below, or `attached top` above), `vertical` (a column beside the content).

events.name: ui-show
events.description: Shown, its entry animation finished (Fomantic's `onVisible`);  the countdown has started.

events.name: ui-close
events.description: About to close:  the countdown ran out, the close icon, a click, Escape inside it, an action, a `--close` invoker command.  `preventDefault()` keeps it (Fomantic's `onHide` returning `false`).  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

events.name: ui-hide
events.description: Closed, its exit animation finished (Fomantic's `onHidden`);  the host is `hidden` now.  `UI.toast()` removes its toasts here.

events.name: ui-approve
events.description: An approve action (`.approve` / `.ok` / `.positive`, `<ui-button positive>`) was activated;  `preventDefault()` keeps the toast open.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

events.name: ui-deny
events.description: A deny action (`.deny` / `.cancel` / `.negative`, `<ui-button negative>`) was activated;  `preventDefault()` keeps the toast open.  Cancelable:  `preventDefault()` vetoes it.

slots.name: actions
